In 2025, Nina Lin went from one of the Internet's most promising stars, to one of it's most hated. First, there was her controversy with Said, the assistant to FaZe Clan member Silky. From there,  Moistcritikal (Penguinz0) and Asmongold took the reigns of the story, calling out Twitch for it's inconsistent moderation and lack of punishment to Nina, and other streamers like her. Today, I tell the full story.
